Balloon mail.question: After the siege, Anglo-French scientist _____ travelled to Burton-on-Trent, where in 1873 he started a business to transport mail from England across the Irish Sea to Dublin
Balloon mail.fact: After the siege, Anglo-French scientist Dr Pierre Wesby travelled to Burton-on-Trent, where in 1873 he started a business to transport mail from England across the Irish Sea to Dublin.

Balloon mail.question: In 1877, a 5-cent stamp for balloon postage was privately printed in Nashville, Tennessee, to carry mail on a June 18 flight of the "_____" from that city to Gallatin, Tennessee
Balloon mail.fact: In 1877, a 5-cent stamp for balloon postage was privately printed in Nashville, Tennessee, to carry mail on a June 18 flight of the "Buffalo Balloon" from that city to Gallatin, Tennessee.
